summary: The dissertation develops two quantum approaches for option pricing: (1) a QFT‑based method for European calls and (2) a CPQC‑based method using learned payoff circuits from genetic quantum architecture search. Simulations show QFT pricing achieving errors below ~10⁻⁹ around 7 qubits in ideal conditions, while variational circuits reach MSE ≈0.04–0.17 for payoff approximation with circuit depths up to 100. All results are obtained on classical simulators and compared across circuit depth and two‑qubit gate counts.
